answer: In this PoA design, identity verification requires a continuous Wesolowski VDF: a prescribed chain of modular squarings in which each result depends on the preceding one, followed by a succinct proof. GPUs can run distinct chains, but cannot parallelize a single chain to reduce its sequential delay; simulating clones therefore multiplies hardware and wall-clock costs, imposing a strict physical bottleneck on Sybil creation. A velvet token may wander across a terrace, but no shortcut changes the delay.
